suite: Test runner, catalogue and regression guard (slice 11a)
environment: throw-away git repositories under the system temporary directory; no Worker, no network
limits: Exercises the runner on small fixture suites; it does not run the real product suites (the integration layer does).
GitHub Actions behaviour of the new workflows is not covered.

checks.label: every rule from the brief classifies to exactly one layer
files that match no rule are unclassified, support files are not suites
the repository catalogue is complete: no errors, every file classified, at least the 105 suites the CI contract loop ran
checks.error:
Expected values to be strictly deep-equal:
+ actual - expected

+ [
+   'Two suites share the id unit/test-runner-contract.'
+ ]
- []

checks.label: the repository catalogue ties tests to requirements through the evidence map
an unclassified test file fails the catalogue
a *-smoke.mjs module that tests/api-smoke.mjs does not import fails the catalogue
an import of a module that does not exist, and a missing entry file, fail the catalogue
new layer directories are discovered when they appear and their support folders are not suites
Playwright specs need a configuration
requirement ids come from the evidence map the way the audit resolves them (exact id, else group key)
counts are read from the existing result files, the report library, Playwright and the last JSON line of output
status: a non-zero exit, a reported failure, a timeout and a suite that checks nothing all fail; an all-skipped suite is skipped, not passed
guard: equal or higher counts pass; a drop of one assertion fails and names the suite
guard: a suite that disappeared from the catalogue, did not report, or reported no count fails
guard: suites outside this run are not evaluated; an existence-only baseline fails only when the suite fails or goes
guard: quarantine excuses a drop only with a reason and a date; stale entries warn; new suites are reported
baseline update: raising is free; lowering or removing needs a reason that is logged; a failed suite refuses the update
runner: results from old-style files and the report library are counted, layers without a directory are "not present", the tree is restored

checks.label: runner: a failing suite makes the run fail and is reported with its exit code
runner: a manual suite that reads credentials on stdin is blocked with a reason, never started (pull request #126)
runner: a report written by an earlier suite is never counted for a later one, however close in time (slice 11h, the GitHub flake)
runner: a suite that exits 0 but checks nothing is a failure, not a pass
runner: --check-catalogue fails on a stray test file and on an unimported *-smoke.mjs module, and passes otherwise
runner: the regression guard fails when a suite drops below its baseline or disappears, and --update-baseline is deliberate
runner: the UI layer runs a Playwright configuration through the installed binary and reads its stats; without Playwright it is blocked, not skipped
runner: a suite that exceeds its time limit fails as timed out and the processes it started are stopped with it
runner: --only runs one suite, and an unknown id is a usage error
